import gzip, hashlib, json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from common import WS, require, start_guard
source = WS / 'control' / 'inputs' / 'n1-planning-kanjidic2.xml.gz'
wanted = set('裕広福多栄資宝貨')
results = {}
guard, _ = start_guard('B124 additional comparison-gloss observation')
class Reader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream, self.digest = stream, hashlib.sha256()
    def read(self, size=-1):
        guard.check()
        data = self.stream.read(size)
        self.digest.update(data)
        return data
try:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with source.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
            guard.check()
            digest.update(chunk)
    require(digest.hexdigest() == 'af0a499d62ac4413c614adcca360e2306490c3f64fccb3510fc7caa15f901bed', 'Compressed source changed')
    with gzip.open(source, 'rb') as stream:
        reader = Reader(stream)
        parser = ET.iterparse(reader, events=('start', 'end'))
        _, root = next(parser)
        for event, node in parser:
            if event != 'end' or node.tag != 'character':
                continue
            literal = node.findtext('literal')
            if literal in wanted:
                require(literal not in results, 'Duplicate character')
                group = node.find('reading_meaning/rmgroup')
                results[literal] = {'meanings': [n.text for n in group.findall('meaning') if n.get('m_lang') in (None, 'en')], 'kun': [n.text for n in group.findall("reading[@r_type='ja_kun']")], 'completeRecordSha256': hashlib.sha256(ET.tostring(node, encoding='utf-8')).hexdigest()}
            node.clear()
            root.clear()
            guard.check()
        require(reader.digest.hexdigest() == '9a000ef112b4bad8f1e6e3ca1f8e9f73ed84c93a5eae93dadfa1513081dc5db8', 'Decompressed source changed')
    require(set(results) == wanted, 'Missing comparison character')
finally:
    memory = guard.finish()
require(not memory['breach'], 'RAM breach')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'PINNED_CHARACTER_GLOSSES_VERIFIED', 'records': results, 'compressedSha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'decompressedSha256': reader.digest.hexdigest(), 'memory': memory, 'limits': 'Coordinator observation only; no source packet, author revision or initial-review input changed. KANJIDIC2 glosses alone do not establish ordinary word usage or resolve all pair decisions.'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

memory.peakScope: Verifier Python process, including its monitor thread; not subprocess peaks.
memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.
